$comment: The import corpus, by hand: what to fetch and how to import it. `node scripts/corpus/pin.mjs` resolves each `ref` to a commit and writes manifest.json (one URL and SHA-256 per file); fetch.mjs reads only manifest.json. Fields: kind (what the file is), dialect (the source's own SQL dialect), importer (sql | dbt | semanticModel | none: no ERD Studio import reads it), pick (sql: folder = the user picks the entry's folder, files = the user picks its files), importAs (sql: the dialect a user would pick when detection names none), root (the repo folder the entry's files keep their paths under), files or dir + include (a regex on the path under root).
